crown.role: the King, primary action, crown moments

materials.piece: authored SVG, flat fill, 3.2px ink stroke, base plate

motion.heroFlatten: pinned scrub, board rotateX 58deg to 0, scale 1.45, end +=85%
motion.ladderFlip: 0.9s expo.out from previous rect; New King shout back.out(2)

components.name: Buy button
components.description: Crown pill on its printed base; pressing pushes it down onto the base.

components.name: Court tile
components.description: A square on the board: rank and coordinate, piece, holder, two mono lines.
components.css: .ds-tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;width:220px;padding:14px 16px;border:3px solid #170c29;border-radius:8px;background:#c6f432;color:#170c29;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #07030f}.ds-tile b{font:400 28px/1 'Dela Gothic One',sans-serif}.ds-tile i{font:600 11px 'Martian Mono',monospace;font-style:normal;opacity:.7}.ds-tile span{font:800 17px Archivo,sans-serif}.ds-tile small{font:600 11.5px/1.35 'Martian Mono',monospace}

components.name: Chess clock
components.description: Escrow toward the next move: crown arc, cream hand, mono readout.

narrative.overview: The holder ladder as a loud toy chessboard mid-game: the biggest holder is the King, fees are moves on a chess clock, sellers are captured.
keyCharacteristics: printed board-game tokens with base shadows
Martian Mono notation for every number and coordinate
rules: Lime and violet are the board; crown orange is the King's
No glass, glows, gradient text or soft shadows
dos: Board coordinates wherever a rank shows
donts: No navy-gold vault or luxury serif
No Unicode chess glyphs or emoji icons
